watchPriceComparison.title: {modelName} market comparison
watchPriceComparison.heading: Official price comparison using {marketName} as the baseline
watchPriceComparison.modeDescription: Refund estimates use each market's tax treatment and verified policy when available. They do not guarantee a refund.
watchPriceComparison.dataBasis: Display currency: {currency}. Official-price and FX dates appear on each market row.
watchPriceComparison.error: Market comparison data could not be loaded.
watchPriceComparison.invalidWatch: The requested watch could not be found.
watchPriceComparison.exchangeRateNotRequired: No FX conversion needed for the display currency
watchPriceComparison.exchangeRateUnavailable: Conversion to the selected currency is unavailable
watchPriceComparison.refundPolicyReference: Pre-tax reference with a verified refund policy
watchPriceComparison.taxRateUnavailable: Tax rate pending confirmation; estimate unavailable
watchPriceComparison.priceUnavailable: Price is unavailable or not listed
watchPriceComparison.estimateExplanation: A pre-tax reference for a tax-inclusive price is calculated as “tax-inclusive price ÷ (1 + nominal tax rate)”. Even where a refund program exists, eligibility, retailer participation, and export validation determine whether a refund can be received.
watchPriceComparison.excludedCosts: This excludes travel, insurance, retailer or refund-operator fees, residency and purchase eligibility, export validation, destination import taxes, local sales taxes, payment-card and FX costs, delivery, availability, and allocation. This compares official prices, not secondary-market prices or guaranteed purchase costs.
